scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -p "[{name}] text" -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "cd backend && bun run dev" "cd frontend && pnpm dev"
scripts.build: cd backend && bun run build && cd ../frontend && pnpm build
scripts.test: cd backend && bun test && cd ../frontend && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit
